description: LANDSCAPE 640x360 PIXEL ART GAME BACKGROUND ONLY. The inviting entrance vestibule of a medieval fantasy training guild, in the SAME visual world as the reference. Frontal camera looking STRAIGHT into the room, not isometric; one coherent single-point perspective. Crisp SNES/16-bit pixel clusters, legible large shapes, controlled palette: slate-blue stone, dark timber, aged brass, muted teal, warm amber light. Left half: one tall grand stone arch with thick open wooden double doors, framed by timber and stone. Through the doorway, a warmly lit EMPTY inner training hall with exposed timber beams, stone floor and a distant arched window looking onto quiet blue-green mountains. Believable door hinges, thresholds and wall thickness. Door opening mostly between x=55 and x=270, no warped duplicate doors. Right half: a simple quiet recessed dark slate stone wall, evenly sized masonry, reserved for a separate login panel covering x=355..610 and y=35..325. Do not paint that panel. Ceiling timber supports along top edge. Floor occupies bottom fifth, level threshold and consistent floor joints with plausible perspective, not a random tile grid. Soft warm light spills out through the left door; right wall remains calm and dark for readable interface contrast. Welcoming, grounded RPG atmosphere, no dramatic bloom or fog. Entire source canvas opaque. Architecture, doors, floor and distant view only. NO characters, UI, text, numerals, logos, signs, buttons, plaques, form, decorative frame, loose props, statues, weapons, boxing ring, furniture, treasure, food, potions, sparkles or visual effects. Do not copy the exact reference room layout: use it for coherent pixel density, materials and palette. Keep the focal doorway fully visible behind the left side of the eventual screen; calm right side and open bottom edge.

reference_images.usage: Reference for the accepted native pixel density, slate-blue stone and timber palette, and frontal camera. New scene is a guild entrance vestibule, with open doors on the left and quiet dark wall on the right.
